t: The DEWALT TSTAK organiser provides robust, versatile storage for small parts and accessories, an essential tool storage solution. This durable plastic organiser is ideal for tradespeople, ensuring components are neatly arranged and accessible on site or in the workshop. A transparent polycarbonate lid allows easy content viewing and maintains product strength. It offers a 7.8 litre capacity across 10 compartments, including two large, six medium and two long sections. Equipped with a heavy-duty ergonomic handle for comfortable transport and anti-rust metal latches for enhanced durability, this water and weather-resistant unit connects seamlessly with other DEWALT TSTAK modules.
b: 2 x Large, 6 x Medium & 2 x Long Compartments
